turns.question: Which customer has spent the most with us over all their orders, and how much?
turns.answer: The semantic layer cannot answer this: no metric or dimension breaks revenue down by individual customer (revenue_eur can be grouped only by customer country, signup date, order status, order date and similar), so I cannot name a top customer or an amount. The closest metrics are revenue_eur (Revenue, non-cancelled orders) and customers_distinct (Active customers), which I can give by customer country or signup cohort instead.
